response.reason: The workload is adversarially constructed: coefficients are chosen so the polynomial nearly cancels at the anchor (value ~0.003) while intermediate Horner quantities are O(1)-O(10) across 49 terms, giving a condition number around 10^3. With per-op float32 rounding over ~48 Horner steps, accumulated absolute error is roughly a few 1e-6 per row against reference values of only ~0.01, i.e. relative error around 2-4e-4, exceeding the 2e-4 tolerance.
